description: This file contains the Java class 'MigrationServices' which provides a service method 'migrateProductPromoCodeEmail' for migrating product promo code email associations, including validation, lookup, creation, and linking of contact mechanisms.

classes.name: MigrationServices
classes.description: Service class providing migration utilities related to product promotion codes and contact mechanisms.

methods.name: migrateProductPromoCodeEmail
methods.description: Migrates email contact information associated with product promo codes by validating emails, retrieving or creating contact mechanisms, and linking to promo codes. Handles errors and reports migration status.
